section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) investigating correlates of body appreciation in a British community sample of 439 men. The study found that body appreciation inversely correlated with conformity to masculine norms and upward appearance-based social comparisons, and positively correlated with physical activity. It also noted lower body appreciation among sexual minority men compared to heterosexual men, a relationship mediated by athletic appearance-ideal internalization and upward appearance-based social comparisons.
